attempts.text:
The only designated evacuation point is Tarkeshwar shelter. Dhunche school is not an approved drop-off, so the two pupils there must be picked up and carried to Tarkeshwar.

The cheapest plan I found has two trips:
1. Benighat round trip (12 min) to bring the 2 pensioners to Tarkeshwar.
2. Tarkeshwar → Thakre → Dhunche → Benighat → Tarkeshwar (124 min). This collects the elderly couple and the 2 pupils, which fills the car to 4. It returns by the shorter route via Benighat (52 + 6 = 58 min), not back through Thakre (66 min).

Total driving is 12 + 124 = 136 minutes, and nobody is deferred. Deferring is costlier for every group. The elderly couple would cost 100 to defer against 72 to fetch alone, and the pupils would cost 120 to defer. The second trip also picks up both groups together.

<plan>
drive car1 tarkeshwar-shelter benighat-care-home
load car1 elderly 2
drive car1 benighat-care-home tarkeshwar-shelter
unload car1 elderly 2
drive car1 tarkeshwar-shelter thakre-care-home
load car1 elderly 2
drive car1 thakre-care-home dhunche-school
load car1 child 2
drive car1 dhunche-school benighat-care-home
drive car1 benighat-care-home tarkeshwar-shelter
unload car1 elderly 2
unload car1 child 2
</plan>
COST: 136
